situations.name: The reed-bank tally
situations.duty: recover marked grain before the bank softens
situations.consequence: the bank becomes a witnessed public landing

situations.name: The wheel lane
situations.duty: hold a moving load clear of the crown wheel
answers: wet and slow the wheel apron
situations.consequence: the mill approach remains open under pressure

situations.name: The flood watch crossing
situations.duty: carry a warning across the divided meadow
situations.consequence: both banks remember the same flood warning

situations.name: The pan-bird line
situations.duty: keep brine out of a nesting strip
situations.consequence: the salt edge keeps a quiet shared lane

situations.name: The wreck-title stand
situations.duty: move one named fitting above the tide
answers: float it along the draining cut
situations.consequence: the wreck fitting reaches a marked dry store

situations.name: The last chain ebb
situations.duty: hold the road while a link is seated
situations.consequence: one final ebb route survives the closing tide

situations.name: The coppice feeding edge
situations.duty: separate fresh shoots from a working trail
situations.consequence: the coppice and trail remain visibly divided

situations.name: The resin-yard smoke turn
situations.duty: move sealed resin away from the burn wind
situations.consequence: the resin rack stands behind a readable firebreak

situations.name: The burn refuge
situations.duty: open a retreat without feeding fire
answers: turn water through the ash bed
call the work parties back together
situations.consequence: the burn leaves a maintained refuge

situations.name: The wool stair
situations.duty: move wet wool without losing the switchback
situations.consequence: the stair keeps a marked passing bay

situations.name: The kiln scree bargain
situations.duty: keep hot lime below a failing shelf
situations.consequence: the kiln road gains an honest warning bay

situations.name: The two-bell span
situations.duty: cross before the face sheds stone
answers: make both crews answer one interval
situations.consequence: the surviving span carries one warning

situations.name: The peat-sledge island
situations.duty: move dry fuel beside a nesting edge
situations.consequence: the island keeps work and nesting margins

situations.name: The smoking bank
situations.duty: stop peat fire without flooding homes
answers: smother the face with wet peat
situations.consequence: the repaired bank holds a named firebreak

situations.name: The divided causeway
situations.duty: recover a plug while water divides the parties
answers: trade safe withdrawal for the plug
situations.consequence: the far bank keeps a second retreat

situations.name: The ore-shelf herd
situations.duty: clear a narrow load shelf without panic
answers: hold work until the herd crosses
situations.consequence: the shelf receives an animal bypass

situations.name: The charcoal span
situations.duty: carry fuel over a disputed brace
situations.consequence: the old span holds a light-load route

situations.name: The tailrace convoy
situations.duty: protect iron through the fracture
situations.consequence: shipment and fracture enter both accounts

situations.name: The seed-clay margin
situations.duty: keep seed above watered clay
answers: draw water into a lower furrow
situations.consequence: the terrace keeps a gleaning margin

situations.name: The kiln-water turn
situations.duty: divide water between firing and shoots
answers: seal a side rill with hot spoil
situations.consequence: the release follows a shared measure

situations.name: The falling terrace
situations.duty: save grain while the face fails
situations.consequence: the failed face becomes a public stair

situations.name: The net-house shoal
situations.duty: free a net without closing the animal channel
answers: raise the net on ice pegs
situations.consequence: the shoal keeps an animal opening

situations.name: The thaw-wool crossing
situations.duty: move wool before the ice braid separates
situations.consequence: the crossing retains a thaw detour

situations.name: The false sounding
situations.duty: recover the true marker under a squall
situations.consequence: the true channel remains marked
